contracts.action: Move notifyOverridesChanged() from the end of persistActive (before the switch commits) to afterCommit, so it runs once the switch is certain, and for every transaction that shares activeTransactionDeps (switch and active-folder relocate).
contracts.equivalent_path: The same function ran inside persistActive (runSwitch) right after workspaceSettings.refresh(target). The relocate path (relocateActive) had no equivalent notify.
contracts.before_after: Before: persistActive did reg.setActive, then refresh(target), then notified. The effective settings and the settingsChanged broadcast switched to the target workspace while the gate was still closed and before dropPendingCaptures and gate.commit. If a later step threw, the old workspace would stay active with the target's effective settings already broadcast. After: persistActive only stores the active id and reads the target's overrides into the cache. The recompute and broadcast happen in afterCommit, after gate.commit(target) and before refreshTitles, broadcastState and broadcastLibraryChanged. The overrides source reads reg.active() and the cache, both already updated by then, so the recompute sees the target's overrides.
contracts.visible_effect: The switch changes the settings in every window and every main listener (shortcuts, tray) together with the title, the workspace list and the library refresh. Nothing shows the new settings early. notifyOverridesChanged returns early when the JSON of the effective settings did not change, so a relocate, which refreshes nothing, causes no extra broadcast.
contracts.failure_mode: switch-transaction.ts:72-77 reopens the gate and aborts the windows when persistActive throws. The notify no longer sits in that window, so a failed switch cannot broadcast the target's settings. If refresh throws after reg.setActive succeeded, the registry stays on the target, as before this change. The move does not change that.

contracts.action: Move three settings:* rows (resolve-pending, reset-overrides, copy-to-all) from above the IPC table's header into the table body.
contracts.before_after: Before: the three rows sat between the intro line and the header, so Markdown did not render them as table rows. After: they follow settings:set-override inside the table and the contents are unchanged.
contracts.visible_effect: The rows render in the docs site's channel table.
